pages.text: Capes are items you earn. When you earn one it goes into your bag. Everyone on the server sees the cape you wear; some have a $(bold)perk$() while worn, and the legendary ones are $(bold)animated$().

$(li)$(bold)Wear it:$() right-click the cape, or put it in the $(bold)Cape$() slot of the Curios panel in your inventory. The eye on the slot hides it without taking it off. Only someone who has earned a cape can wear it.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Show it off:$() right-click an $(bold)armor stand$() with a cape to hang it there (the one already on it comes back to you). Sneak and right-click the stand with an empty hand to take it back. A broken stand drops its cape. Any cape can go on a stand, earned or not.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Your collection:$() ESC → Capes, or $(#e0ac46)/capes$(). Every cape there is: the ones you have, ho

w to earn the rest (with how far along you are), each perk, and where to get another if you lose one. It also puts a cape from your bag on, or takes yours off.$(br2)Unlocks announce themselves in chat. On death a cape goes where the rest of your things go (your grave).

pages.title: Skill capes
pages.text: One per skill, at level 99. Each has a perk while worn.

pages.title: Lost a cape?
pages.text: Whoever makes a cape will make you another, as long as you earned it: speak to them and choose $(italic)I've lost a cape$(). Your collection shows who makes each cape and what it costs.
